triggers.symptom: Quoted 12% APR compounded monthly/quarterly, asks for true annual rate

triggers.action: Ordinary annuity formula gives PV at t=3 (one period before first CF). Then divide by (1+r)^3 to reach t=0.

triggers.symptom: Mutually exclusive projects: A has higher IRR (28%), B has higher NPV (5.1 Cr)
triggers.action: Always pick B (higher NPV). IRR is scale-blind and cannot be added across projects.
2 sign changes = up to 2 positive IRRs. Discard IRR and decide strictly via NPV.

triggers.symptom: Equipment with unequal lives (2 yrs vs. 3 yrs) replaced repeatedly
triggers.action: Divide each machine's PV of total costs by its respective Annuity Factor PVAF(r, n); pick lowest EAC.

triggers.symptom: Peer has Equity Beta 1.5 and D/E = 0.5; evaluating an all-equity project
Given ROE = 18% and dividend payout = 40%, asks for growth g
1-for-4 Rights Issue at Rs 80 when cum-rights price is Rs 120
triggers.action: TERP = (4*120 + 1*80)/5 = Rs 112. Value of 1 right (per existing share) = 120 - 112 = Rs 8.

triggers.symptom: High-P/E Acquirer buys Low-P/E Target in zero-synergy stock deal
triggers.action: EPS rises mechanically, but combined P/E contracts so share price is unchanged without real synergy.

triggers.symptom: Unrelated firms merge with zero synergy; bankruptcy risk falls
triggers.action: Debt gets safer (Bondholders gain), Equity loses an equal amount unless the firm re-leverages.

formula_web.title: Formula Dependency Web
formula_web.summary: See how every Corporate Finance equation derives from core Discounted Cash Flow (PV) and Risk-Return (Variance -> Beta -> CAPM) chains.

nodes.label: PV & Compounding
bullets: Annuity Due = Ordinary Annuity * (1 + r).
Continuous compounding: FV = PV * e^(r * t).
nodes.trap: Always match rate frequency (r/m) with number of periods (n*m).

nodes.label: Perpetuity -> Growing -> DDM & PVGO
nodes.short: Infinite cash flows collapse to C / (r - g), powering stock valuation.
bullets: g = ROE * Retention Ratio (b = 1 - payout).
Bond Price = Coupon * PVAF(YTM, N) + Face / (1+YTM)^N.
Exact Fisher: (1 + r_real) = (1 + r_nom) / (1 + inflation).
nodes.trap: Use D_1 (next year's dividend), not D_0; if D_0 is given, multiply by (1+g).

nodes.label: NPV, PI & EAC
nodes.short: NPV obeys Value Additivity; PI handles rationing; EAC handles unequal lives.
bullets: Ignore sunk costs; include opportunity costs & cannibalization.
Capital rationing (divisible): rank by PI = PV / I_0.
nodes.trap: For borrowing projects (+ at t=0, - at t=1), accept ONLY if IRR < r.

nodes.label: Portfolio Var -> Beta -> Asset Beta -> CAPM
nodes.short: Diversification leaves only market Beta; unlever peer Beta before pricing.
bullets: CAPM: r_i = r_f + Beta_i * (E[R_m] - r_f). Alpha = E[R] - r_CAPM.
Beta = Cov(R_i, R_m) / Var(R_m).
nodes.trap: Do not forget the 2*wA*wB*Cov term or the square root when finding portfolio SD.

nodes.label: Rights TERP & M&A Synergy
nodes.short: Pro-rata rights preserve wealth; M&A NPV = Synergy minus Premium.
bullets: Value of 1 Right (per existing share) = P_cum - TERP = (TERP - P_sub) / N.
Synergy = V_AT - (V_A + V_T); Premium = Price Paid - V_T.
nodes.trap: Check whether the question asks for value of 1 right (per old share) vs. rights needed per new share.

modules.title: M1 & M2: Principles & TVM
modules.summary: Corporate forms, wealth maximization, EAR/APR, annuities, and delayed cash-flow shifting.

nodes.label: Corporate Goal & Business Forms
nodes.short: Shareholder Wealth Maximization (NPV) beats accounting profit.
bullets: Stock price (stock variable) prices timing & risk; accounting profit (flow) ignores both.
Public/Private Corp = limited liability + perpetual life; LLP/OPC = hybrid limited liability.
Real intangible assets (patents/brands) generate cash vs. Financial assets (claims).

nodes.label: EAR, Continuous, Delayed Annuities
nodes.short: Shift cash flows cleanly; match compounding periods.
bullets: Annuity formula PVAF lands at t-1 (1 period before first payment).
Amortized Loan PMT = Loan / PVAF(r, n). Rule of 72 = 72 / r%.
Negative yield -> PV > FV.
nodes.trap: For payments starting at t=4, discount the t=3 annuity PV back 3 years, NOT 4.

modules.title: M3 & M4: Bonds, Stocks & Cap Budget
modules.summary: Bond pricing/duration/HPR, Gordon DDM/PVGO, and why NPV beats IRR/Payback.

nodes.label: Bonds, Fisher, HPR & Stocks
nodes.short: Coupon < YTM -> Discount; Longer maturity -> higher rate risk.
bullets: Semi-annual bonds: halve annual coupon, halve YTM, double N.
HPR > YTM if market yields fall before maturity (capital gain).
P_0 = D_1/(r-g); PVGO = P_0 - E_1/r; Perpetual AT1 = Coupon / YTM.

nodes.label: NPV vs. IRR, Payback, PI & EAC
nodes.short: NPV is King; watch Multiple IRRs, Borrowing IRRs & Scale Bias.
bullets: Value Additivity: NPV(A+B) = NPV(A) + NPV(B).
Crossover Rate = IRR of incremental cash flows (B - A).
Discounted Payback adds TVM but still ignores post-cutoff cash flows.

modules.title: M5 & M6: Risk, CAPM & Payouts
modules.summary: Diversification, Beta/SML, MM Payout Equivalence, Homemade Dividends & Signaling.

nodes.label: Diversification, Beta & SML
nodes.short: Only systematic Beta is priced; positive alpha = above SML (underpriced).
bullets: When correlation rho = -1, equal-risk 50/50 portfolio hits 0% SD.
Adding a high-SD stock can LOWER portfolio risk if covariance is low/negative.
Unlever peer Equity Beta -> Asset Beta = Beta_E / (1 + D/E).

nodes.label: MM Irrelevance, Buybacks & Splits
nodes.short: Dividends and Buybacks yield identical wealth in frictionless markets.
bullets: Buyback reduces shares & cash equally -> share price stays unchanged at fair value.
Homemade Dividends: sell shares at ex-div price to manufacture cash.
Bonus/Splits = zero cash change; Reverse Split avoids exchange delisting.
nodes.trap: Regular dividend cuts signal permanent earnings weakness; special dividends do not.

modules.title: M7 & M8: Financing, IPOs & M&A
modules.summary: Primary vs. OFS, Winner's Curse, Rights math, and real vs. dubious M&A motives.

nodes.label: IPOs, SEOs, Rights & Callable Bonds
nodes.short: OFS goes to sellers; Rights protect existing owners; Callable bonds pay higher yield.
bullets: Money left on table = (Day-1 Close - Offer) * Shares (indirect underpricing cost).
Winner's Curse: uninformed retail gets full allotment in cold issues.
SEO negative announcement (-2% to -3%): Myers-Majluf overvaluation signal.

nodes.label: M&A Synergy vs. 4 Dubious Motives
nodes.short: Targets capture most gains; beware Hubris, Agency, EPS Fallacy & Co-Insurance.
bullets: Real synergy = scale/scope, complementary R&D, removing weak management.
Hubris = honest winner's curse overconfidence; Agency = self-interested empire-building.
EPS Accretion without synergy contracts blended P/E; Co-Insurance enriches bondholders.

traps.fix: PVAF for first CF at t=4 lands at t=3; discount by (1+r)^3, not (1+r)^4.

traps.trap: Using Payout Ratio instead of Retention Ratio in g = ROE * b
Using D_0 instead of D_1 in Gordon Growth P_0 = D_1 / (r - g)
traps.fix: Check whether the dividend just paid (D_0) or next year's dividend (D_1) is given.

traps.trap: Approximating Fisher real rate as r_nom - inflation
Picking highest IRR on mutually exclusive projects of different scale
Accepting a borrowing project (+ then -) because IRR > cost of capital
traps.fix: Borrowing projects reverse the rule: accept ONLY if IRR < r (check NPV directly).

traps.trap: Using peer Equity Beta directly for an unlevered project
Thinking a share buyback automatically boosts stock price immediately
traps.fix: Fair-value buybacks reduce cash and shares proportionally—price per share stays unchanged.

traps.trap: Adding Offer for Sale (OFS) proceeds to firm's primary capital raised
traps.fix: Only Fresh Issue proceeds enter the firm; OFS cash goes to selling shareholders.

traps.trap: Assuming Co-Insurance from unrelated merger helps shareholders
traps.fix: Safer debt transfers value TO bondholders FROM equity unless the firm re-leverages.
